method.name: dd_median3_paired_anchor128
method.time_sampler_note: Each adjacent pair has one U[0,.1) anchor and one U[.1,1] context time from an antithetic draw, with random assignment to its samples. Marginal prefix probabilities: k=0 is .5; k=1..9 are 1/18 each.
method.train_notes: Official DD EMA initialization under dd-selfproto-v1.3. 128 targets, three proposals per original label, stable lower-median LPIPS-distance selection, one pass, uniform weights. Frozen training and evaluation settings are supplied exclusively by the trainer.

embedding_loss: LPIPS-alex-v0.1 on decoded continuous-head suffix and teacher prefix
classification_loss: CE averaged over generated tokens of all scales
teacher_reuse_note: Each pass visits every pair once; stop earlier when the GPU budget ends.
